links.outcome: Gender and skin-tone representation of medical imaging professionals in text-to-image outputs
links.effect: 60.6% of 391 characters were male and 87.7% light skin tone; light skin tone was 100% for Midjourney 5.2, 94.8% DALL-E 3, 84.8% Stable Diffusion 2.1, 70.3% Firefly 2; men were 76.7% in Midjourney.
links.quote: Nonetheless, DALL-E 3 includes inherent biases associated with gender and ethnicity that demand more critical evaluation.

screen.reason: Evaluates demographic bias (gender and skin tone representations) of text-to-image generative AI models when generating images of medical imaging professionals.
